'''Xavier Vieira de Vasconcelos''' (born 14 January 1992) is an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] who plays for [[FC Pas de la Casa|Pas de la Casa]]<ref>{{Soccerway|128903}}</ref> and who has represented the [[Andorra national football team]].<ref>{{NFT player|pid=53862}}</ref>

==International career==
Vieira played his first international game with the national team on 15 October 2013, in a friendly against [[Hungary national football team|Hungary]] where he came in as a substitute for [[Edu Peppe]] after 80 minutes.<ref name="eu-foot">{{cite web | url=http://eu-football.info/_match.php?id=1409|publisher=eu-football.info |title=Hungary football team defeated Andorra 2:0, 15 October 2013 |access-date=15 Jul 2014}}</ref>
